enums.name: Book
enums.doc: An enumeration for different books that appear within the Bible

text.name: TextPlacement
text.doc: Places some type of text to some location within another text

props.name: parentId
props.doc: Id of the text where the placed text appears

props.name: placedId
props.doc: Id of the text that is placed within the parent text

props.name: orderIndex
props.doc: 0-based index that indicates the specific location of the placed text

text.name: StatementPlacement
text.doc: Common trait for models which are used for placing statements within various texts

props.name: statementId
props.doc: Id of the statement which appears within the linked text

bible.name: Translation
bible.doc: Represents a translation covering one or more Bible books

props.name: abbreviation
props.doc:
A shortened version of this translation's name. 
Empty if there is no abbreviation.
Time when this translation was added to this database

bible.name: BookTranslation
bible.doc: Represents a translated specific book of the Bible

combo.name: ContextualBook
combo.doc: Includes information about this book's translation

props.doc: Id of the translation this book is part of

bible.name: BookStatementPlacement
bible.doc: Links a statement to a book in which it is made

combo.name: VerseBeginningStatementPlacement
combo.doc: Represents a statement link that begins a verse. Includes verse marker information.

props.name: bookId
props.doc: Id of the book where the statement appears

bible.name: VerseMarker
bible.doc: Locates a verse marker within a text

props.name: chapterIndex
props.doc: A 1-based index that indicates which chapter this verse belongs to

props.name: verseIndex
props.doc: A 1-based index that indicates which verse this is

props.name: firstStatementId
props.doc: Id of the book statement that starts this verse

bible.name: Footnote
bible.doc: Represents a foot note made within the original text, concerning a specific word or a statement within the text

combo.name: FootnoteWithStatementPlacements
combo.doc: A footnote which includes links to the statements made

props.name: commentedStatementId
props.doc: Id of the specific statement this footnote comments on

props.name: targetedWordIndex
props.doc:
A 0-based index that specifies the word targeted within this statement. 
None if no specific word was targeted.

bible.name: FootnoteStatementPlacement
bible.doc: Links a footnote to a statement made within it

props.doc: Id of the footnote where the statement is made
